```{r global-options, include=FALSE}
# Code chunks are shown but not executed: the analysis needs the input files of the
# study, which are not part of this code repository. Set eval = TRUE (or run a chunk

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
```

# SMR

This document merges every source file of the SMR folder. The SMR 1.3.1 executable is
used to test whether the effect of a gene or of a plasma protein on obstructive sleep
apnea and on the five overnight oximetry traits is mediated by a shared cis-acting
variant, and the HEIDI test is used to separate pleiotropy from linkage.

The shell scripts build the besd files from the pQTL summary statistics and run the
SMR tests for the blood and brain layers; the R scripts collect the per-chromosome
results, apply the FDR correction and export the significant probes/genes.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `SMReQTL_AHI_code.txt`

```{bash "SMReQTL_AHI_code.txt", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMReQTL_AHI_code.txt (shell script)
# ===========================================================================
#blood mRNA SMR
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --gwas-summary Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_SMR.txt --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/Whole_Blood --maf 0.01 --out Path/SMR/Blood_AHI --thread-num 10

cat Sig_Blood_AHI_gene.txt | while read line;
do
echo "Now extracting gene:"$line
var=${line:0:(-1)};
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/Whole_Blood --query 1 --probe "$var" --out Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/AHI/blood_"$var"
echo "Gene "$var" has finished"
done


#brain mRNA SMR
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --bfile Path/g1000/EUR --gwas-summary Path/datasource/GWAS_data/AHI_SMR.txt --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9 --maf 0.01 --out Path/SMR/Brain_AHI --thread-num 10

cat Sig_Brain_AHI_gene.txt | while read line;
do
echo "Now extracting gene:"$line
var=${line:0:(-1)};
Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/smr-1.3.1-win.exe --beqtl-summary Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9 --query 1 --probe "$var" --out Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9/AHI/brain_"$var"
echo "Gene "$var" has finished"
done
```

## `SMReQTL_AHI_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "SMReQTL_AHI_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMReQTL_AHI_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the blood mRNA SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/SMR/")

results<-read.delim("Blood_AHI.smr",header = TRUE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

Sig_TWAS<-read_excel("Path/TWAS/BloodGene_AHI_TWAS_Sig.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
Sig_TWAS$ID_t<- substring(Sig_TWAS$ID,1,15)
results<-results[which(results$probeID %in% Sig_TWAS$ID_t),]
results$fdr<-p.adjust(results$p_SMR,method = "fdr",n = length(results$p_SMR))
results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")
write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Blood_AHI.xlsx")
results<-subset(results,results$fdr<0.05)
results<-subset(results,results$p_HEIDI>0.01)
write.xlsx(results,"Sig_Blood_AHI.xlsx")

write.table(results$probeID,"Sig_Blood_AHI_gene.txt",row.names = F,col.names = F,quote = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the brain mRNA SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/SMR/")

results<-read.delim("Brain_AHI.smr",header = TRUE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

Sig_TWAS<-read_excel("Path/TWAS/BrainGene_AHI_TWAS_Sig.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
Sig_TWAS$ID_t<- substring(Sig_TWAS$ID,1,15)
results<-results[which(results$probeID %in% Sig_TWAS$ID_t),]
results$fdr<-p.adjust(results$p_SMR,method = "fdr",n = length(results$p_SMR))
results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")
write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Brain_AHI.xlsx")
results<-subset(results,results$fdr<0.05)
results<-subset(results,results$p_HEIDI>0.01)
write.xlsx(results,"Sig_Brain_AHI.xlsx")

write.table(results$probeID,"Sig_Brain_AHI_gene.txt",row.names = F,col.names = F,quote = FALSE)
```

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the plasma protein SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/SMR/")

results$fdr<-p.adjust(results$p_SMR,method = "fdr",n = length(results$p_SMR))
results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")

write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Plasma_MinSpo2.xlsx")
results<-subset(results,results$fdr<0.05)
results<-subset(results,results$p_HEIDI>0.05)
write.xlsx(results,"Sig_Plasma_MinSpo2.xlsx")
